visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a man's hands forming a heart shape over a cardboard cutout of a girl. The man wears a light beige shirt and a black cap. The background is a brightly lit indoor restaurant with displays of food. (2) The camera pulls back as the man claps his hands and begins a high-energy walking motion toward the right. He is standing in front of a 'Kira Base' signage. A promotional poster for 'Peeta Taketake' is visible on his left. (3) A young woman with long dark hair and a blue apron serves a yellow bowl of food onto a table. The scene cuts to the man holding two yellow bowls filled with healthy ingredients like corn, egg, and meat. (4) The man is now seated at a table with four yellow bowls in front of him. He holds a fork and speaks to the camera, gesturing toward the food. The lighting is soft and warm. (5) Close-up shots show white sauce being poured over a bowl containing beef, corn, and edamame. The man gives a thumbs-up to the camera while chewing. (6) The man and the young woman are dancing in a studio-like setting with a large digital screen background displaying vibrant red and yellow geometric patterns. They are both smiling and moving in sync with the rhythm. (7) The video concludes with the man seated at the table again, giving a final thumbs-up and pointing toward his social media profile handle overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice asking a question over a bright, high-tempo electronic dance beat. A sharp 'hit' SFX occurs as the male voice takes over. (2) The main speaker (male) delivers a friendly, energetic narration. The BGM features a steady four-on-the-floor beat with synthesizer pads. (3) A rhythmic 'clinking' sound of ceramic bowls being placed is audible over the speech. The male voice maintains a moderate speech rate with high clarity. (4) As the narration describes the food, the BGM remains consistent in the background. A 'pouring' sound effect mimics the visual of the sauce. (5) The track shifts as a Japanese vocal layer enters the music, sounding like an anime-style J-Pop track. The male narrator gives a thumbs-up 'mmm' sound. (6) During the dance sequence, the music volume increases, featuring high percussive energy and bright synth stabs. No speech occurs during this brief phase. (7) The male narrator returns to conclude with a polite closing statement. A final UI 'ping' sound effect marks the appearance of the social media handle.
